title: failure history
description: keep track of 20 most recent failures in local storage and prune them in LRU fashon. Every 4 random dates the game asks it should randomly pick one of the dates from the failure history giving a chance to excercise the dates that are most likely to fail. Basically implement some sort of spaced repetition. You can even implement a proper spaced repetition algorithm. But also include a mix of purely random dates
